taxon.note: Scientific and common names as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.height_typical_m.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 346, Sedum divergens: flowering stems erect or ascending, usually decumbent at base, 5 cm to 12 cm high.

traits.life_span.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 346, Sedum divergens: a perennial.

traits.perennation.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 346, Sedum divergens: with slender branching rootstocks.

traits.rhizome_habit.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 346, Sedum divergens: slender branching rootstocks.

traits.clonal.note: Spreading in low mats, set by hand from iNaturalist photos of flowering plants (observations 378002695, 60769001, 126755, 381175489, 29407004, 299205197, 381175669, 4854771): the flora gives no count or measure.

traits.rosette.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 346, Sedum divergens: leaves along the sterile shoots and stems, with no rosette.

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 346, Sedum divergens: leaves, at least those of the sterile shoots, opposite.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 346, Sedum divergens: leaves 5 mm to 8 mm long.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 346, Sedum divergens: obovate to broadly so, or the upper spatulate.

traits.leaf_apex.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 346, Sedum divergens: rounded or obtuse at apex.

traits.leaf_margin.note: Entire leaf edges, set by hand from iNaturalist photos of flowering plants (observations 378002695, 60769001, 126755, 381175489, 29407004, 299205197, 381175669, 4854771): the flora gives no count or measure.

traits.leaf_hairs.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 346, Sedum divergens: glabrous.

traits.inflorescence.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 346, Sedum divergens: cyme rather compact.

traits.inflorescence_length_m.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 346, Sedum divergens: cyme 5 cm broad or less.

traits.units_per_inflorescence.note: 5 to 15 flowers and buds in a cyme, set by hand from iNaturalist photos of flowering plants (observations 378002695, 60769001, 126755, 381175489, 29407004, 299205197, 381175669, 4854771): the flora gives no count or measure.

traits.flower_merosity.note: Five petals to a flower, set by hand from iNaturalist photos of flowering plants (observations 378002695, 60769001, 126755, 381175489, 29407004, 299205197, 381175669, 4854771): the flora gives no count or measure.

traits.corolla_shape.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 346, Sedum divergens: petals spreading: a flat star.

traits.petal_length_m.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 346, Sedum divergens: petals 5 mm to 6 mm long.

traits.petal_shape.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 346, Sedum divergens: petals narrowly lanceolate.

traits.flower_size_m.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 346, Sedum divergens: petals 5 mm to 6 mm long, spreading, so the flower about twice that across.

traits.flower_colour.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 346, Sedum divergens: petals yellow; sRGB by eye from the photos.

traits.flowering_months.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 346, Sedum divergens: flowering July to September.

appearance.note: By eye, from the photos the traits cite: red stems; small, plump, rounded leaves in pairs, green flushed red to wholly red; small clusters of yellow star flowers.

generator.params.note: Set by hand for spreading stonecrop from Abrams's description and the photos the traits cite: the herb program's structure (stems, nodes, basal leaves, how the flowers are borne). Its inflorescence is drawn as one cluster at each stem's tip, sized by the traits, so the stem ends where the cluster begins. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: 0.11 m tall at 3 years in the open, within the flora's range. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.
